seoTitle: LOKA at AEON Japan Fair 2023 Phnom Penh
description: LOKA showcased premium Japonica rice and Wagyu beef , delighting over 500 visitors with authentic Japanese flavors.
title: AEON Japan Fair 2023: A Resounding Success
body:
Our company is thrilled to announce our successful participation in the AEON Japan Fair 2023, held on November 9th, 11th, and 12th. During the event, we took centre stage to promote our premium Japonica rice and Wagyu beef, captivating the palates of over 500 enthusiastic visitors.

From the outset, our focus was on showcasing the exquisite flavours and culinary versatility of our Japonica rice and Wagyu beef. Our booth was abuzz with activity as visitors eagerly lined up to sample these delectable offerings. The Wagyu beef, renowned for its rich marbling and melt-in-your-mouth texture, proved to be a crowd-pleaser, while the Japonica rice, known for its delicate sweetness and fluffy consistency, delighted rice enthusiasts alike.

The overwhelming positive response from the fair’s attendees was a testament to the exceptional quality of our products and the dedication of our team. We are confident that our participation in the AEON Japan Fair 2023 will significantly boost the sales of our Japonica rice and Wagyu beef, further solidifying our position as a leading provider of premium Japanese culinary delights.

Embark on a culinary adventure and discover the exquisite flavours of our Japonica rice and Wagyu beef. Visit the AEON store today and experience the essence of Japanese gastronomy.

seoTitle: LOKA Most Popular Booth CAMFOOD 2023 Phnom Penh
description: LOKA won Most Popular Booth at CAMFOOD 2023 in Phnom Penh, attracting over 3,000 visitors with premium Japanese products .
title: A Triumph At Camfood 2023 As The Most Popular Booth
location: Diamond Island Convention And Exhibition Center
body:

This Emerging Player In The Industry Not Only Showcased Its Diverse Range Of Products But Also Left A Lasting Impression On Visitors.

At Camfood 2023, LOKA Food And Beverage Stood Out By Offering An Array Of Delectable Samples. More Than 3,000 Of Visitors Flocked To Our Booth During The Three Days Event, Enticed By The Opportunity To Taste Exceptional Products Imported Solely From Different Areas Of Japan. Among The Highlights Were The Fresh Fish, Future Fish, Azuma Nishin, Sake, Kitoku Rice And Various Other Imported Delicacies, Notably The Ever-Popular Japanese Premium Sake Exclusively From Nabeshima And Suigei. Each Sample Served As A Testament To LOKA’s Commitment To Delivering Quality And Flavor, Leaving A Memorable Mark On The Taste Buds Of Attendees

In Addition To The Resounding Success In Providing Delightful Samples, LOKA Food And Beverage Received A Significant Accolade – The “Most Popular Booth” Award. This Recognition Underscores The Company’s Dedication To Creating A Captivating And Engaging Exhibition Experience. Visitors Clearly Appreciated Not Only The Exceptional Products But Also The Booth’s Design And Presentation.

Beyond The Samples And Awards, LOKA Food And Beverage Used Camfood 2023 As An Opportunity To Connect With Industry Professionals And Enthusiasts. The Event Served As A Platform For Forging New Partnerships And Strengthening Existing Ones. It Was A Chance To Share Insights, Innovations, And The Passion For The Culinary World.

As LOKA Food And Beverage Basks In The Success Of Its Camfood 2023 Participation, Our Company Is Eager To Carry This Momentum Forward. With A Commitment To Excellence, We Are Poised To Expand Our Reach And Continue Delighting Customers With Premium Food And Beverage Offerings.

In Conclusion, LOKA Food And Beverage’s Presence At Camfood 2023 Was Nothing Short Of Extraordinary. From Presenting Numbers Of Products To The “Most Popular Booth” Award, We Made A Significant Impact. As We Look To The Future, LOKA Remains Dedicated To Our Vision And Mission Of Delivering Exceptional Culinary Experiences And Forging Meaningful Connections Within The Industry. Our Continual Journey Is Undoubtedly One To Watch In The World Of Food And Beverage.

title: LOKA Honored with Best Display Product Award at Camfood+Camhotel’24
body:
AMFOOD 2024 was Cambodia’s leading international food and beverage exhibition, attracting exhibitors and visitors from around the world. The event provided us with a unique platform to network, showcase our products, and explore new opportunities in the Cambodian market.

We at LOKA Japanese Foods & Beverage were proud to participate in Camfood+Camhotel’24, marking our third consecutive year at this prestigious event. Held at Koh Pich Exhibition from November 6th to 8th, 2024, we showcased our extensive range of premium Japanese products, reflecting our years of experience and commitment to excellence.

Our award-winning display featured a curated selection of premium Japanese products, including:

  • Azuma Nishin: A classic Japanese canned fish, perfect for quick and easy meals.
  • Plant-Based Seafood: Sustainable and delicious alternatives to traditional seafood.
  • Premium Sake and Shochu: A refined taste of Japanese spirits.
  • High-Quality Nori: Essential for crafting authentic sushi and other Japanese dishes.
  • Wagyu Beef: Indulging in the rich, marbled flavors of Japanese wagyu.
  • Frozen Udon and Ebi: Convenient and versatile ingredients for home cooking.

This recognition was a testament to our dedication to providing the highest quality Japanese products to the Cambodian market. We are grateful to the organizers of Camfood+Camhotel’24 for this honor and to our valued customers for their continued support.

With a legacy of delivering top-quality Japanese food and beverage products, we have established ourselves as a trusted name in the Cambodian market. Our team of experts carefully curates a selection of products that cater to diverse tastes and culinary needs.

description: Discover LOKA Japanese Food Exhibition Makro Sen Sok 2021. Enjoy tastings, product displays, and special promotions.
title: LOKA Food & Beverage as the Best Booth Winner at CAMFOOD AND CAMHOTEL’22
body:
LOKA Food & Beverage recently participated in the prestigious sake event "Niigata Sake no Jin 2024" held in Niigata Prefecture, Japan. Inspired by the renowned Oktoberfest beer festival, "Niigata Sake no Jin" was established in 2004 to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the Niigata Prefecture Sake Brewers Association. Like Oktoberfest, the event aims to celebrate local produce and connect people through delicious food and sake.

Niigata boasts the highest concentration of sake breweries in Japan, and "Niigata Sake no Jin" reflects this rich heritage. This year's event, held on March 3rd, 2024, was one of the largest, bringing together around 80 breweries. LOKA Food & Beverage had the opportunity to participate and engage in successful business discussions with several prominent sake breweries such as Tenryohai, Abe, Kamonishiki, Koshimeijo, and Kato.

This participation in "Niigata Sake no Jin" is a significant step for LOKA Food & Beverage. The company sees this as a key opportunity to connect with leading Japanese sake producers and bring the luxurious and refined taste of Niigata sake to the high-end market in Cambodia.

title: LOKA Triumphs at Gashikoukan-kai in Cambodia, Showcasing Premium Japanese Sake
body:
In a splendid display of cultural exchange, LOKA Food&Beverage. proudly participated in the prestigious Gashikoukan-kai (賀詞交換会) held at the Embassy of Japan in Cambodia on January 20, 2024. The event, known for fostering goodwill and camaraderie, brought together diverse participants from various business industries.

One of the highlights of the evening was LOKA Food&Beverage's generous sponsorship, contributing premium Japanese Sake to elevate the experience of attendees. The selected sake for the occasion was the exquisite Nabeshima Daiginjyo, a testament to the company's commitment to offering top-tier products.

The Nabeshima Daiginjyo, exclusively imported from Japan to Cambodia by LOKA Food&Beverage, took center stage as the company presented this rare and high-quality Japanese sake to the event. The gesture aimed not only to celebrate the occasion but also to showcase the company's dedication to bringing authentic Japanese cultural experiences to Cambodia.

As participants savoured the distinct taste of Nabeshima, LOKA Food&Beverage. received a cascade of positive feedback. Many attendees expressed their appreciation for the rich flavour and quality of the sake, further solidifying the company's reputation for delivering excellence.

Beyond the culinary delights, LOKA Food&Beverage. leveraged the event to strengthen its network within the business community. The company successfully engaged with participants from various industries, fostering connections that are poised to contribute to the growth and vitality of its business.

The successful participation in Gashikoukan-kai reflects LOKA Food&Beverage's commitment not only to its business objectives but also to creating happiness for all stakeholders. As the company continues to bridge cultural gaps through its premium offerings, it sets the stage for more meaningful collaborations and connections in the future.

title: LOKA Food and Beverage Presents Toba Meats and Japonica Rice at the upcoming Aeon Japan Fair 2023
body:
Experience the flavors of Japan at the upcoming exhibition at the Japan Fair 2023, hosted at Aeon Mall Phnom Penh. This exciting event will run from the 1st to the 12th of the month.LOKA Food and Beverage is proud to announce that we will open our booth to the public on the 9th, 11th, and 12th, ensuring that you can join us in savoring the delectable offerings.

At the heart of our exhibit is an exquisite selection of meats, sourced directly from Toba Meats Japan, a prestigious provider renowned for their commitment to quality and exceptional taste. The star of our showcase is the impressive range of meat cuts, showcasing seven different varieties. From succulent tenderloins to robust ribeyes, there's a flavorful option for every palate. For meat lovers, this is an opportunity to embark on a sensory adventure that will leave your taste buds tingling with delight.

In addition to presenting the delectable Toba meats, we are proud to feature Japonica rice from Kitoku as part of our exhibit. This high-quality rice variety is celebrated for its subtly sweet flavor and delightful texture, making it an ideal complement to the nuanced and intricate tastes of Japanese cuisine.

This culinary event offers an exciting platform to immerse yourself in Japanese gastronomy, a cuisine celebrated for its diversity and rich heritage. Whether you're a devoted lover of Japanese cuisine or a newcomer eager to explore, the Japan Fair 2023 is the perfect opportunity to savor authentic dishes that embody tradition and innovation.

Join us at the LOKA Food and Beverage booth as we invite you to embark on this delectable journey. It's not just a food exhibition; it's a cultural experience that opens the door to the captivating world of Japanese cuisine. We eagerly await the chance to share our passion for these exquisite flavors with you. Prepare to be enchanted by the tantalizing aromas and tastes that await at our booth.

title: I participated in the Jetro sake event, a sake tasting event held at Vatanak Capital.
body:
With the rise in income levels in recent years, high-quality Japanese products have come to Cambodia. This time, a tasting event for sake was held. We also participated in this event among more than 100 special guests as part of the sake provider. The event was organized by the Japanese Embassy in Cambodia and introduced sake from more than 20 different regions of Japan.

In addition to introducing Japanese culture and cuisine, the purpose of participating in this event was to obtain new discoveries about sake. Sake is becoming more and more popular in this country, and we have been able to feel more attractive by listening to tastings and stories.

Over the last few years, Cambodia has experienced economic growth and rising incomes have increased demand for high quality products. Therefore, sake, known for its high quality and advanced craftsmanship, is rated as a product as a high demand.

Participants received a high reputation for the quality of sake provided and the abundance of variety. Many people said they wanted to learn more about Japanese culture and cuisine and would like to try more Japanese products in the future.

The tasting fair of sake was a great success throughout. We enjoyed the Japanese culture and food for the people of Cambodia, and we were able to introduce many of the high quality products available from Japan. As Cambodia's income continues to rise, demand for premium products like sake will increase further.

title: LOKA Food & Beverage as the Best Booth Winner at CAMFOOD AND CAMHOTEL’22
location: Diamond Island Exhibition & Convention Center (DIECC) in Phnom Penh
body:
After a three-year hiatus, we are excited to announce the returning of the enormous Culinary and Hospitality Expo of CAMFOOD and CAMHOTEL 2022 took place in DIECC from 16 to 17 November. For the very first time, it was incredibly a great opportunity for S.E.A.T.S Inc to participate in this event to present as one of the food importer and wholesaler known as LOKA Food & Beverage.

This global exhibition organized annually by the Cambodia Tourism Federation, the Cambodian Chefs Association, the Cambodian Restaurant Association, and the Cambodian Hotel Association with the aim of revitalizing and developing Cambodia’s HOREKA (Food and Hospitality) in Cambodia.

To celebrate the rebound of this event, a widely gathering of exhibitors was surprisingly reached to over 150 booths from 100 companies along with approximately 9,000 attendees participated and indulged the feast for the sense. This ultimate gastronomy and hospitality exhibition attracted not only a diverse range of exhibitors display variety of products and services but also professionals and decision-makers from the food and hotel sectors, such as chefs, hotel managers, restaurant owners, and buyers.

Embark of this topmost quest of the worldwide culinary and hospitality expedition, we, as one of the food and beverage importer and wholesaler among the 16 international anticipators, are pleased to introduce our products to over 3,000 visitors who had visited our booth during these three days event for the new bites experience as the passport to unlock a new destination. Regarding to our products showcase, we got to display a diverse range of products featuring from fresh fish, meat to other foods and beverages we produced and imported by our own.

During these gastronomic and hospitality expedition, we strived to offer our current and new customers with a truly unique and unforgettable new bites experience as well as tantalized the interest of our products to other business owners. Ultimately, the strenuous of our product exhibiting activity has made us become one of the Topnotch known as the Winner of the Best Booth Award at CAMFOOD&HOTEL 2022. In respect of the support from our consumers and other businesses, we promise to put more effort to always serve you with the best quality and unique experience in gastronomic expedition.
